title: Free ww2 flight simulator
author: Silly_Application642
selftext: Created with opus and deepseek in the Godot engine. Completely free project feel free to leave any feedback or suggestions

comments.author: Smart_Armadillo3472
comments.body:
This is awesome. Are the maps and battle details historically accurate?  
Not sure if this is your intention for the project, but the idea of AI-generated recreations of historic battles is fascinating. I can imagine this sort of thing having real-world applications as AI gets better and better. Personally I'd lean into that stuff, and try and have the maps and battle details as accurate as possible.

Fully appreciate it might just be a fun setting for a dogfighting game though, so other than the above, it looks like it's enjoyable to play judging from the clips. I think if historical realism isn't your aim then it might need something else to draw people in, e.g. some other kind of interesting game mechanic or hook. There are a decent number of these kinds of games out there, so considering a USP would be worthwhile.

replies.author: Silly_Application642
replies.body:
There are historical missions and I'm currently trying to get the dam busters campaign working correctly. If you have anything you'd like adding specifically let me know and I'll try my best. I'm limited to my time playing all the missions so if you get any bugs let me know.

 I plan to carrying on working on this indefinitely so feature's will be added and tweaked. 
Thanks for the kind words.
Craig
